title: Hello, Python!
explanation: The print() function shows text in the Output panel. Text inside quotes is called a string.
challenge: Change the message so Python prints something about you.
hint: Keep your message between the quotation marks.

title: Remember values
explanation: A variable gives a value a memorable name. Python uses = to store the value on its right.
challenge: Create a second variable for your favorite color and print it.
hint: Follow the favorite_food example, using a new variable name.

title: Ask a question
explanation: input() pauses the program for an answer. PyNivo lets you type that answer below the Output panel.
code:
name = input("What is your name? ")
print(f"Nice to meet you, {name}!")
challenge: Ask the learner for their favorite hobby and respond to it.
hint: Store the result of a second input() call in a variable.

title: Make a decision
explanation: An if statement runs indented code only when its condition is true. else handles the other case.
challenge: Add a special message when age is exactly 13.
hint: Put an elif age == 13 branch between if and else.
